headlines.text: Rewind to 2025, when Bandido vs. Mascara Dorada fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.63 ? a stone-cold classic. Bandido retained the ROH World Championship over Mascara Dorada in a rematch of their Arena Mexico classic, the two shaking hands and embracing afterward.

Looking back to 2023, when a new champion was crowned for the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles as The Embassy vs. Young Bucks & Page battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.16 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Swerve Strickland's distraction pulled Page away from the ring at the worst moment, letting Mogul Embassy steal the pin on Matt Jackson to reclaim the ROH Six-Man Tag Titles.
On this day in 2024, Leila Grey returned to the fold after a long-awaited absence after just under 2 years away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Jericho & Omega was no more, reborn as The Golden Jets after 3 matches, on Dynamite.
On a Saturday in 2025, back when Olympia made their AEW debut against Mercedes Mone, appearing on Collision, rated 6.36.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Hikaru Shida vs. Willow Nightingale clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.74.
